findings.passage: I strongly believe in the 2nd amendment and in our Arizona State Article 2, Section 26 protections. We have very strong gun ownership protections in Arizona and I would work strongly to defend them. Law abiding citizens should not be prohibited from protecting themselves! I also strongly believe in constitutional carry.
findings.note: His answer on the iVoterGuide 2026 questionnaire to 'What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety?' Undated.
